dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings with irregular, crenulated perimeters exhibiting a sharp gradient transition from a bright exterior ring to a dark-centered interior across the dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, bright, asymmetrical speckle clusters lacking internal gradients concentrated in the lower mid-section where the body meets the posterior flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli on the upper back form a distinct scalene triangle, while smaller clusters on the lateral side form a nearly linear sequence.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent interconnected reticulated lattice pattern where individual ring structures merge into a continuous network across the upper dorsal-lateral surface.
